title: Appendix A: Testing-window results
intro: This appendix lists every forecast scored in the findings. Table A1 gives each match in the testing window, its result and the forecast from every source. Tables A2 to A8 then score each source separately, one match per row, with running totals. Table A9 lists the run record behind each agent forecast. Matches are numbered in kickoff order, and the same number is used in every table.

Each row is calculated in the same way. P(home) is the probability given to the home side. If a source picked the home side, P(home) is its confidence. If it picked the away side, P(home) is one minus its confidence. The XGBoost model gives P(home) directly, and its pick is the side it gives more than 0.50. Home win is 1 if the home side won and 0 if it lost. Correct is 1 if the picked side won. The Brier term is (P(home) − home win)², and the Brier score for a set of matches is the mean of those terms. The running columns include every match up to and including that row.
Round labels: R23 to R27 are Rounds 23 to 27, FW1 and FW2 are finals weeks 1 and 2, PF is the preliminary finals and GF is the grand final.

tables.title: All forecasts and results
tables.note: Each forecast is shown as the picked team and the confidence given to it. The model column is the model's home-win probability. A dash means the system did not forecast that match. The model has no probability for two Round 27 matches because their run records were not kept.
